title: PM YASASVI (PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India):
summary: Schemes — PM YASASVI (PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India):

items: o Objective: Financial aid for education and hostel facilities for OBC, EBC, and DNT students
o Eligibility: Family income below Rs. 2.5 lakh per year
 Post-matric (Graduation): Rs. 5000 to Rs. 20,000 per year
 Top Class School Education (Class 9-12): Rs. 75,000 to Rs. 1.25 lakh per year
 Top Class College Education: Rs. 2 lakh to Rs. 3.72 lakh per year
